correctness.rationale: PASS: The positive diagonal fixed-point equation for T(x)=a x/(1+x)[u+v x²/(H+x²)] is cubic P(x)=x³-Lx²+Hx-HK with K=au-1>0, L=a(u+v)-1>K, H=h²>0. P(-y)<0, so all real roots are positive. Its discriminant H[-4H²+QH-4L³K], Q=L²+18LK-27K², has Q²-64L³K=(L-9K)³(L-K); this proves exactly L>9K and H_-<H<H_+ for three positive roots, folds at endpoints, and triple cusp L=9K,H=27K². T strictly increases, and T(r)-r sign together with derivative formula gives outer diagonal multipliers in (0,1), middle >1; planar eigenvalues T'(r) and (2p-1)T'(r) yield outer sinks, middle instability. Rational a=10,u=17/110,v=6/11,H=11,p=3/5 has T=x(17+7x²)/((1+x)(11+x²)) and T-x=-x(x-1)(x-2)(x-3)/((1+x)(11+x²)). Independently exact SymPy calculation verified discriminant factor, derivative (7x^4+120x^3+214x²+187)/((1+x)^2(11+x²)^2), and positivity coefficients [176,726,215,12,62,6,3] of (3-T') numerator. Thus 0<T'<3 and global difference contracts by factor 3/5, excluding asymmetric full-system fixed points at the example. Exact multipliers 17/11,11/12,47/45,37/40 give origin unstable, outer sinks, middle hyperbolic saddle. Implicit function theorem gives their persistence under small admissible C^1 perturbations. Global all-parameter absence of asymmetric equilibria is not claimed.
